lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਝ ਕਰੀਜੈ ਗੁਣਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajh kareejai gunah keree chhod avagan chaleeai ||
lines.translation: Let us form a partnership, and share our virtues; let us abandon our faults, and walk on the Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰੇ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕਰਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahire pata(n)bar kar ada(n)bar aapanaa piR maleeai ||
lines.translation: Let us wear our virtues like silk clothes; let us decorate ourselves, and enter the arena.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਭਲਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਝੋਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai jaai baheeai bhalaa kaheeai jhol a(n)mrit peejai ||
lines.translation: Let us speak of goodness, wherever we go and sit; let us skim off the Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁਲਾ ਕਢਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gunaa kaa hovai vaasulaa kadh vaas laeejai ||3||
lines.translation: One who has a basket of fragrant virtues, should enjoy its fragrance. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee ||
lines.translation: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਜਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭੂਲੜਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan taa kau jaaeeai je bhoolaRaa hoee ||
lines.translation: Go ahead and complain to Him, if He makes a mistake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਭੂਲਾ ਜਾਇ ਕਹੀਐ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਿਉ ਭੁਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je hoi bhoolaa jaai kaheeai aap karataa kiu bhulai ||
lines.translation: If He makes a mistake, go ahead and complain to Him; but how can the Creator Himself make a mistake?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣੇ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਕਹਿਐ ਦਾਨੁ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਿਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sune dekhe baajh kahiai daan anama(n)giaa divai ||
lines.translation: He sees, He hears, and without our asking, without our begging, He gives His gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਦਾਤਾ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: daan dei daataa jag bidhaataa naanakaa sach soee ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver, the Architect of the Universe, gives His gifts. O Nanak, He is the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai hor kare na koee ||4||1||4||
lines.translation: He Himself acts; unto whom should we complain? No one else does anything. ||4||1||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee ||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee pauRee saach kee saachaa sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: Truth is the ladder to the Guru; climbing up to the True Lord, peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਟਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sahaj aavai saach bhaavai saach kee mat kiu talai ||
lines.translation: Celestial peace comes; the Truth pleases me. How could these True Teachings ever be erased?

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨੁ ਮਜਨੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਛਲਿਓ ਕਿਉ ਛਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: isanaan daan sugiaan majan aap achhalio kiu chhalai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is Undeceivable; how could He ever be deceived by cleansing baths, charity, spiritual wisdom or ritual bathings?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਦੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: parapa(n)ch moh bikaar thaake kooR kapat na doee ||
lines.translation: Fraud, attachment and corruption are taken away, as are falsehood, hypocrisy and duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man raataa gun ravai man bhaavai soee ||1||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with His Glorious Praises; I chant them, and He is pleasing to my mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin kaaran keeaa ||
lines.translation: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਨਿ ਮੈਲਿਐ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mail laagee man mailiai kinai a(n)mrit peeaa ||
lines.translation: Filth sticks to the polluted mind; how rare are those who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: math a(n)mrit peeaa ihu man deeaa gur pahi mol karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Churn this Ambrosial Nectar, and drink it in; dedicate this mind to the Guru, and He will value it highly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRaa prabh sahaj pachhaataa jaa man saachai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: I intuitively realized my God, when I linked my mind to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis naal gun gaavaa je tis bhaavaa kiu milai hoi paraaiaa ||
lines.translation: I will sing the Lord's Glorious Praises with Him, if it pleases Him; how could I meet Him by being a stranger to Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saahib so saalaaheeai jin jagat upaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: So praise your Lord and Master, who created the creation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai gaiaa kee na aaio kiu aavai jaataa ||
lines.translation: When He comes, what else remains behind? How can there be any coming or going then?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: preetam siu man maaniaa har setee raataa ||
lines.translation: When the mind is reconciled with its Beloved Lord, it is blended with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਕਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib ra(n)g raataa sach kee baataa jin bi(n)b kaa kot usaariaa ||
lines.translation: True is the speech of one who is imbued with the Love of his Lord and Master, who fashioned the body fortress from a mere bubble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਨਾਇਕੋ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch bhoo naaiko aap sira(n)daa jin sach kaa pi(n)d savaariaa ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the five elements; He Himself is the Creator Lord. He embellished the body with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham avaganiaare too sun piaare tudh bhaavai sach soee ||
lines.translation: I am worthless; please hear me, O my Beloved! Whatever pleases You is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai saachee mat hoee ||3||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with true understanding, does not come and go. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਤੈਸਾ ਅੰਜੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan taisaa a(n)jeeai jaisaa pir bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Apply such an ointment to your eyes, which is pleasing to your Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਝੈ ਸੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: samajhai soojhai jaaneeai je aap jaanaavai ||
lines.translation: I realize, understand and know Him, only if He Himself causes me to know Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਾਣਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਲੇਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap jaanaavai maarag paavai aape manooaa levae ||
lines.translation: He Himself shows me the Way, and He Himself leads me to it, attracting my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਅਭੇਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam sukaram karaae aape keemat kaun abhevae ||
lines.translation: He Himself causes us to do good and bad deeds; who can know the value of the Mysterious Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)d na jaanaa raam ridai man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: I know nothing of Tantric spells, magical mantras and hypocritical rituals; enshrining the Lord within my heart, my mind is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਤੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan naam tisai te soojhai gurasabadee sach jaaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The ointment of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is only understood by one who realizes the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਰ ਘਰ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan hovan aapane kiu par ghar jaahee ||
lines.translation: I have my own friends; why should I go to the home of a stranger?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan raate sach ke sa(n)ge man maahee ||
lines.translation: My friends are imbued with the True Lord; He is with them, in their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man maahi saajan karahi raleeaa karam dharam sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In their minds, these friends celebrate in happiness; all good karma, righteousness and Dharma,
